description: Conditional, not a transcription: from the four open Cogito premises, thinker-local accessibility, the thinker-local anti-brute-root principle and excluded middle, some bearer of an occurring thought has a concrete ground-ancestor existing at w and at every world accessible from w. The two thinker-local premises are strictly weaker than #487's global ones. Accessibility-relative necessity only; no uniqueness, underivedness, simplicity, intellect or God. All six non-logical premises open; no root change.
